question_selection.method: First 300 questions in original source order with at least one validated correct and one validated incorrect existing response across the nine MAM USMLE workbooks. Questions, reference answers, predictions, and selected responses are copied verbatim.

accuracy_method: Preserve prior workbook filename target percentages. Correct count is round-half-up(target_percent * 300 / 100); actual accuracy is correct_count / 300. Files are constructed combinations and do not represent measured TRUSS performance.
